messages:
Ava Chen: OK team — kicking off the newsletter + webinar launch sequence for the 'Benchmarking Inference at Scale' webinar. Main goals: drive 2k signups, surface benchmark narrative in post-launch, and move Dev/Platform trial accounts to demo funnel.

Carla Nguyen: quick Q — what's the proposed send cadence? and are we doing a separate launch email vs webinar invite? :thinking_face:

Ava Chen: plan I sketched:
- Day 0: Launch email (all newsletter subscribers segmented) — announce report + webinar CTA
- Day 3: Webinar invite (targeted to active eng/dev cohorts + previous webinar no-shows)
- Day 7: Reminder + social proof (bench highlights)
- Day 14: Follow-up with recording + trial CTA for attendees + nurture for absentees

We will run a short nurture (3 emails) for inbound leads who click but don't sign — 3/7/14 day cadence.

Mike Patel: send windows by region? we should avoid midnight hits for APAC.

Ava Chen: good call. Proposed time slots:
- Americas: 10:00–11:00 PT (captures US East mid-day)
- EMEA: 10:00–11:00 GMT
- APAC: Sunrise slot 09:00–10:00 SGT / JST (use locale fallback)
We will use timezone-tuned sends in HubSpot (local-send) and stagger by 15–30m to smooth throughput.

Jonah Reed: segmentation rules draft (keeping it simple):
- Tier A: Product-active (used >3 API calls/week last 30d) + company size >= 50 — primary webinar invite
- Tier B: Product-trial but low activity — nurture path + webinar invite with reminder
- Tier C: Newsletter-only / cold leads — single announce email, recapture with social proof
- Exclusions: customers who attended last 3 months, unsubscribed, or already signed for webinar signup list

Carla Nguyen: subject line tests? I can queue two variants per send.

Ava Chen: yes — run A/B on subject + preheader. Two variants to start:
A: "New benchmark: Inference cost & latency at 1M tokens/day — Live webinar"
B: "How top teams cut inference costs 3x — join our benchmark webinar"
Preheader A: "See hard numbers and tuning tips from production workloads"
Preheader B: "Practical ops plays for predictable inference economics"

Sasha Morales: need hero image + 2 social cards and a 30s promo clip. Asset deadline = Thu COB. Can design pick up the attendee quote copy?

Ava Chen: assigning tasks:
- Sasha: hero + cards + clip (due Thu COB)
- Jonah: segment exports & suppression lists (due Tue EOD)
- Mike: HubSpot flow + tagging & UTMs (due Wed morning)
- Carla: subject/preheader variants & copy for 3-email nurture (draft by Wed EOD)

Jonah Reed: UTMs — here's a template to use, paste into all CTA links:
```
?utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=benchmark_launch_2026&utm_content={variant}
```
Make sure link shortener OK for final send.

Mike Patel: also adding a custom contact property: "webinar_interest" to preserve who clicked vs registered vs attended. We'll use it to trigger dedicated post-webinar drips.

Carla Nguyen: suppression question — do we suppress customers who have a Dedicated contract? They might be in target but require account team coordination.

Ava Chen: yes — exclude Dedicated accounts from automated send. We'll run an enterprise-only invite via AE outreach. Jonah — add Dedicated tag to suppression list.

marketing-bot: Reminder: assets due in 48 hours for thread 1754444444 — please update status in #marketing-assets when ready.

Sasha Morales: noted — will upload hero + cards to the asset folder and ping here when done.

Carla Nguyen: will draft variants today and post for review by 5pm. :thumbsup:

Ava Chen: perfect. Post-launch notes: capture top 3 benchmark soundbites for social copy and a short blog summary. We'll also extract 4 slides from the webinar for a quick 'bench cliffnotes' email.

Mike Patel: tracking checklist before send: UTMs in every CTA, open + click pixels enabled, unsubscribe header present, seed list validation, and final render checks across Gmail/Outlook/Apple Mail.

Ava Chen: team — let's sync briefly tomorrow 9:30 PT for preflight. If cards/UTMs/flows are green we'll push to schedule. Thanks! :rocket:
